value: Democrats preset tariff -10 pts ('this Page's estimate'): exceeds the whole post-2024 increase (Yale ~8.5-8.7 pts above a ~2.4% 2024 baseline; collected-duty rate ~7.1%). Recommend -5 to -8.5 pts, central ~-7, labelled estimate, depending on which duties the bill ends.

Republicans '$5,000 tariff dividend, ~$1.2tn': tariff revenue base shrank after IEEPA was struck down; Yale projects ~$1.9tn over 10 yrs from current-law tariffs. Check the dividend source is post-Feb 2026 and note refunds of IEEPA duties.

No explicit baseline effective-tariff figure on the canvas; add 'Current US average tariff 7.1-11.1% (collected vs statutory), as of Jul-Oct 2026'.
